I will add in next patch, thanks
What is this FRU?  Can we come up with a better name than including "rackmon" here?  rackmon is a downstream implementation of phosphor-modbus.
This module is handling rs485 for modbus, RS232 for CPU and BMC management debug port, and BMC MGMT port. Can we conclude the module as MGMT board?

I have modified the board name to MGMT board, please help a look.
Thanks.
No need for "AND" here.  Use a single probe.
I will modify to single probe, thanks.
I'd prefer if this were CANbus or similar.  "BUS" isn't an acronym.
Thanks for reply, I will modify to "CANBus" for the module name
Can we spell this out as "Management"?  I don't think we should be making up an abbreviation.
OK, I'll modify to "Ventura2 Management Module" in next patch
Why is "Rackmon" showing up in the EEPROM data?  That's strange.
I will told to the team member for this EEPROM data to remove the RACKMON related words.
